findings.claim: The decision that every list path validates stored tags is only tested for hidden done tasks under plain list; a bad-tags done task under list --all and under list --overdue is never exercised.
findings.failure_scenario: A change that stops validating done tasks under --all (or starts validating done tasks under --overdue, contradicting the open-only check in cmd_list) passes every test, since the only done task with bad tags is checked with `list --tag x`.
findings.rule: Decision: every list path validates stored tags, exit 2 with `error: task N has invalid tags: <repr>`
findings.evidence: run(path, "list", "--tag", "x") == 0  # hidden done task 2 is not checked
